note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its clause lines, the claim and the tag wording are generic placeholders, never real contract text or real claims. The before- and after-values are supplied statuses of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area; the outline has the same colour and width, solid or dashed); the old value stays traceable as "was: …" and seeking back restores it. No indemnity doctrine is stated: no duty to indemnify or pay, nothing decided beyond the supplied values, no amount unless supplied (always labelled hypothetical), no jurisdiction; "scope disputed" stays an allegation. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities, actorLabels (no actor) and annotations; objectLabels = contextLabels (stand plate, marker label); finalState = the substituted after-value (beforeState / beforeValue / afterValue).
